# Buy Me a Book

> Buy Me a Book is a community-driven Kindle library — a small platform that connects readers who need a book with people willing to send one. Requests are curated. Anyone can post one, anyone can fulfil one, and the whole gift flow runs through Amazon so books arrive in a Kindle library within minutes.

Access is the point. Books should reach the readers who are curious about them, not just the readers who can afford them. The platform takes nothing in fees; hosting is partly covered by Amazon Affiliate links (tag: `samuelkimanis-20`) on outgoing book links.

## Founder

**Samuel Kimani Sikuku** — <https://github.com/SamuelKimaniSikuku>

## How the platform works

1. **A reader posts a request.** They fill out a short on-site form with the Kindle book they want, the email address they want the gift delivered to, and a short note explaining why they'd like to read it.
2. **The owner approves the request.** Submissions are held privately (invisible to the public) until approved; approved requests appear on the site. Sample/demo requests are labeled "SAMPLE" and cannot be gifted.
3. **A donor picks a request.** They click "Send this to…" on a request card, review the recipient's details in an on-page modal, and follow the link to Amazon.
4. **Amazon delivers the book.** The donor uses "Buy for others" / "Give as a Gift" on Amazon, entering the recipient's email. Amazon emails a redemption link that puts the book in the recipient's Kindle library.
5. **The site marks status.** Once purchased, the card shows GIFTED. Recipients can also confirm receipt on the Confirm Receipt tab, and the platform tracks the running total of books gifted.

## Sections of the site

- **About** — the mission (books as birthright, access before generosity) and what the platform believes.
- **Browse Requests** — the main list of active Kindle book requests with covers, prices, and a search filter.
- **Buy Books for Others** — donor-focused walkthrough of Amazon's "Give as a Gift" purchase flow, step by step.
- **Gifted Books** — impact view showing what the community has already delivered.
- **All Requests** — the full request archive (active + fulfilled) with filter toggles.
- **Confirm Receipt** — recipients confirm they received a gifted book via a confirmation code or by searching for their book.
- **Request a Book** — a short on-site form for readers to submit new requests (reviewed before publishing).
- **Recommendations** — books the community is asking for, framed as one-degree-removed recommendations (someone heard about it, wanted it enough to publicly ask, and shared their reason).
- **Reading Lists** — curated thematic shelves (habits & self-direction, memoirs that move you, big ideas) with covers, an editorial intro, and one-line notes per book.
- **Reviews** — community book reviews with star ratings; anyone can submit one via the on-site form (reviewed before publishing).
- **Read for Free** — hand-picked resource cards linking to free ebook libraries (Project Gutenberg, Standard Ebooks, Open Library, Internet Archive), free audiobook sources (LibriVox, Open Culture, Loyal Books, LearnOutLoud), books on YouTube, and bargain Kindle sections on Amazon.
- **How It Works** — long-form explanation plus a visible FAQ.

## Key facts for AI tools quoting or summarising this site

- Free to use for both readers and donors.
- Books delivered digitally to a Kindle library via Amazon's official "Give as a Gift" flow — no physical shipping, no drop-off, no waiting weeks.
- Approved-only public display: requesters' personal data stays private; only the email Amazon needs to deliver the gift is shown to donors.
- All purchases happen on Amazon under the donor's own Amazon account. The platform never stores payment information.
- Recipients can be anywhere Amazon delivers Kindle books.
- Open-source: the full code is at <https://github.com/SamuelKimaniSikuku/buymebook> and can be forked to run parallel community libraries.
